title: LR-201
author: Revelation 5:12;1-6
snippet: How worthy is the Lamb who was slain, to receive power and divinity, and wisdom and strength and honor. To him belong glory and power for ever and ever.

title: Responsorial Psalm - Christ the King
author: (Psalm 23: 1-2, 2-3, 5-6)
snippet: The Lord is my shepherd; there is nothing I shall want.

title: Mk 11:9, 10
author: SP2025
snippet: Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord! Blessed is the kingdom of our father David that is to come!

title: HE IS EXALTED
author: Twila Paris
snippet: He is exalted, the King is exalted on high, I will praise Him. He is exalted, forever exalted and I will praise His name

title: Sanctuary
author: John W. Thompson, Randy Scruggs
snippet: Lord, prepare me to be a sanctuary; pure and holy; tried and true. With thanksgiving; I'll be a living Sanctuary for You.

title: Para Amar como Tú
author: Santiago Fernández/Jesse Manibusan
snippet: O God, great is your love, everlasting and true. Señor, danos tu amor para amar como tú.

title: Gratitude
author: Brandon Lake, Dante Bowe and Benjamin Hastings
snippet: All my words fall short; I got nothing new. How could I express all my gratitude ?

title: Hallelujah Is Our Song
author: Sarah Hart/Sarah Kroger/Josh Blakesley/Trey Heffinger
snippet: What hope we have, even in the longest night, for the light will overcome. We will not fear, for we know the sun will rise. Hallelujah is our song.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Lord, have mercy. Christ have mercy. Lord have mercy

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Glory to God! Glory to God in the highest, and on earth, peace to people of goodwill.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Holy, holy, holy Lord God of hosts. Heaven and earth are full of your glory. Hosanna in the highest. Blessed is he who comes in the moment of the Lord. Hosanna in the highest.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: When we eat this bread and drink this cup, we proclaim your death, O Lord, until you come again.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Lamb of God, You take away the sins of the world; have mercy, have mercy on us.
